items.name: Fish
items.industryClue: Caught in waters and used as food.
items.industryExplanation: Fisheries harvest fish and other aquatic foods. Fish belong in Fisheries.
items.kindExplanation: Fish are a resource harvested for food. A fishing pole is equipment used to catch them.

items.name: Lobster
items.industryClue: A shellfish harvested from the ocean.
items.industryExplanation: Lobster is seafood harvested by fisheries. “Fisheries” includes shellfish as well as fish.
items.kindExplanation: Lobster is an animal resource used as food, rather than equipment.

items.name: Fishing pole
items.industryExplanation: A fishing pole is equipment associated with fisheries. It helps catch a resource; it is not itself a natural resource.
items.kindClue: A person uses it to catch fish.
items.kindExplanation: A fishing pole is a tool. It helps people harvest fish, which are the resource.

items.name: Evergreen tree
items.industryClue: A tree that can supply wood.
items.industryExplanation: Forestry manages forests and supplies wood from trees. This tree belongs in Forestry.
items.kindClue: A living thing that supplies wood.
items.kindExplanation: A tree is a natural resource. Its wood can be used to make products such as lumber and paper.

items.name: Lumber
items.industryClue: Wood cut into boards for building.
items.industryExplanation: Lumber is a product made from trees. Its resource connection is Forestry.
items.kindClue: Boards made by processing tree wood.
items.kindExplanation: Lumber is a resource product. It is made from wood and can be used to build many things.

items.name: Axe
items.industryExplanation: An axe is a tool associated with forestry. It helps work with wood; the wood is the resource.
items.kindClue: A person uses it to cut wood.
items.kindExplanation: An axe is a tool. It helps people work with a resource, rather than being the wood they collect.

items.name: Tractor
items.industryClue: Used on farms to pull equipment and work the land.
items.industryExplanation: A tractor is equipment associated with agriculture. It helps grow or harvest crops.
items.kindClue: A machine that helps people do farm work.
items.kindExplanation: A tractor is equipment. It helps farmers grow and harvest crops, but it is not a crop or farm animal.

items.name: Wheat
items.industryClue: A crop grown in fields and made into flour.
items.industryExplanation: Wheat is a crop. Growing crops is part of Agriculture.
items.kindClue: A grain grown and harvested for food.
items.kindExplanation: Wheat is a grown resource. Its grain can be processed into foods such as flour.

items.name: Livestock
items.industryClue: Farm animals raised for food or other products.
items.industryExplanation: Livestock are farm animals. Raising them is part of Agriculture.
items.kindClue: Farm animals that supply food and other products.
items.kindExplanation: Livestock are farm resources. They can supply products such as milk, wool or meat.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.industryClue: Used to break rock while looking for minerals.
items.industryExplanation: A pickaxe is a tool associated with mining. The rock or mineral is the resource being worked.
items.kindClue: A person uses it to break rock.
items.kindExplanation: A pickaxe is a tool. It helps people work with rocks and minerals.

items.name: Diamonds
items.industryExplanation: Diamonds are minerals obtained through mining. They belong in Mining.
items.kindExplanation: Diamonds are a mineral resource. They are materials obtained from the Earth.

items.name: Rock & ore
items.industryClue: Rock deposits that may contain useful minerals or metals.
items.industryExplanation: Mining obtains minerals, metals and some rock materials. Ore is material containing minerals that may be extracted.
items.kindExplanation: Rock and ore are resource materials, rather than the equipment used to extract them.

items.name: Fuel pump
items.industryClue: Equipment that delivers fuel to vehicles.
items.industryExplanation: A fuel pump is equipment associated with the oil and gas industry. The fuel it delivers is a resource product.
items.kindExplanation: A fuel pump is equipment. The fuel it delivers is the resource product.

items.name: Oil in a drum
items.industryClue: The card represents oil stored in a container.
items.industryExplanation: Oil is a petroleum resource. The drum is its container; sort the oil with Oil & gas.
items.kindClue: Sort the oil inside, rather than its container.
items.kindExplanation: This card represents oil, a resource. The metal drum is only the container.

items.name: Natural gas
items.industryClue: A fuel obtained from underground deposits.
items.industryExplanation: Natural gas is an energy resource obtained from underground deposits. It belongs in Oil & gas.
items.kindClue: A fuel obtained from the ground.
items.kindExplanation: Natural gas is a resource used as fuel. The pipes and equipment used to carry it are tools and infrastructure.
